N7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
A module mean is not a gene. Predicting that a group of genes rises is a weaker
claim than predicting which ones, and N6 measures how much weaker.
Modules are discovered from CO-CHANGE, which is a correlation and not a mechanism.
Loop 187 measured that this project's regulatory network does not explain
co-expression, so a module here need not correspond to a regulon.
Replicate 4 is the scorer, and loop 218 measured that replicate 4 agrees with 2 and
3 no better than any other pair -- the only real agreement in this dataset is
between 2 and 3. Discovering on the one agreeing pair and scoring on an outlier is
the strictest available test and also the harshest.
Eight intervals is a very short series to cluster trajectories on.
